pagerduty-bot: PAGERDUTY ALERT — High error rate and queue growth on inference-pool-eu-west (GPU pool). Priority: P1. svc: inference-serving, impacted: production.
Anna (oncall-sre): Acknowledged. Pulling metrics now.
Anna (oncall-sre): Queue length spiked from 200 -> 12k in ~8m, 95th latency > 6s, token throttles showing.
Jay (eng-runtime): Seeing lots of 'no placement available' errors in runtime logs. Likely binpacking + MIG mismatch.
Tom (infra): Autoscaler attempted scale but hit max nodes config (max=120). Throttled, backoff engaged.
Priya (eng-ml): Could be MIG fragmentation — smaller slices are abundant but large-model pods require bigger slices. We have stranded capacity in incompatible MIG sizes.
Anna (oncall-sre): Customer impact: CS flagged 3 high-usage customers with timeouts and degraded throughput. Lisa, can you confirm?
Lisa (customer-success): Confirmed — customers "AcmeAnalytics" and "RetailXL" reporting timeouts and failed inference jobs. They're on Dedicated but fallback to hosted failed.
Marcus (platform): Opening capacity ticket to cloud to request emergency GPU add. But repack/evict might be faster.
Jay (eng-runtime): Dumping recent scheduler traces: ```
I0312 14:18:05 scheduler.go:122] placement failed: no compatible node for pod=model-large-2026-03
I0312 14:18:07 allocator.go:88] candidate nodes: 0/48 match required MIG(7g.1)
```
Anna (oncall-sre): Starting mitigation plan: 1) Evict preemptible/low-priority jobs 2) Scale down smaller MIG pools to create larger slices via reassign 3) Temporarily lower min-batch to reduce memory per request 4) Bump autoscaler max to 160 if needed.
Tom (infra): Eviction script started: `./tools/evict-low-prio --pool inference-pool-eu-west --dry-run=false --threshold=30m`
Tom (infra): Evicted ~58 low-priority pods, freeing 12 GPUs but they're fragmented.
Priya (eng-ml): Repack attempt: submitting repack job to allocator: `repacksvc --from-mig=small --to-mig=large --target=6` — starting now.
IncidentBot: NOTE: Repacks can take ~5-12m; they cause transient scheduler thrash. Proceed with caution.
Jay (eng-runtime): While repack in flight, pushing a runtime fallback: route low-priority traffic to quantized model v2-q that fits smaller MIGs. Deploying canary.
Anna (oncall-sre): Canary started, initial success — 22% of low-priority traffic diverted. Queue growth for critical model hasn't reduced yet.
Marcus (platform): Cloud requested justification for burst GPUs. I submitted emergency request, ETA 18m for provisioning additional nodes.
Lisa (customer-success): Informing affected customers: sending status note and estimated mitigation timeline ~30m.
Anna (oncall-sre): Running tail of runtime logs for placements to confirm freed capacity consumption: ```
I0312 14:25:11 allocator.go:info: repack allocated 4 GPUs into MIG(7g.1)
I0312 14:25:13 scheduler.go:info: bound pod model-large-2026-03 -> node-7
```
Priya (eng-ml): However, we've got many pods requesting 16GB contiguous MIG; available are 8GB slices mostly. That causes stranded capacity — nodes have free GPU memory but in incompatible partitions.
Jay (eng-runtime): Implementing interim workaround: enable multi-tenant slicing flag to allow model to run on two adjacent 8GB slices (experimental). Flip now? @Anna
Anna (oncall-sre): Approved for emergency. Enable flag and monitor.
Tom (infra): Flag enabled: `SCHED_MULTI_SLICE=true`. Note: needs allocator patch roll, deploying.
Jay (eng-runtime): Patching allocator: `kubectl -n infra set image deployment/allocator allocator=ghcr.io/redwood/allocator:hotfix-multislice-20260312`
IncidentBot: Deploy initiated. Rolling update 24 pods.
Anna (oncall-sre): Monitoring metrics. Queue length down from 12k -> 4.5k after evictions + canary + repack progress. Error rate still elevated.
Marcus (platform): Cloud pool added 8 nodes early (ETA met). New capacity shows up but reporting as 'incompatible' because node GPU configuration differs — need repack to consume.
Priya (eng-ml): Suggest temporarily lowering resource request of non-critical pods to fit larger slices. Proposal: patch resourceRequests for model-bench and feature-writer to 0.75x. Jay ok?
Jay (eng-runtime): Doing it. `kubectl patch` rolling updates in progress.
Lisa (customer-success): Customers acknowledge. AcmeAnalytics asks for SLA credit estimate. I'm collecting logs.
Anna (oncall-sre): Timeline update to channel: evictions + canary + repack + multi-slice feature reduced queue by ~62% in 20m. Still need full repack + allocator backfill.
Tom (infra): Repack job completed. Allocator reports 22 new large-compatible slices allocated.
Jay (eng-runtime): After repack and multi-slice, placement failures dropped to single-digit per minute. Latency 95th down to 1.9s.
Priya (eng-ml): Quality note: quantized fallback increased error rate for a subset of prompts by ~3% — tracked under eval job `regress-20260312-qf`.
Anna (oncall-sre): Customer impact update: timeouts reduced significantly; primary customers report improvement but still intermittent errors for heavy tails.
Marcus (platform): Recommend follow-ups: 1) Increase autoscaler max from 120->180 for eu-west temporarily 2) Create long-term repack schedule 3) Re-evaluate default MIG sizing for large models -> propose new standard MIG size.
Anna (oncall-sre): I'm opening post-incident ticket with RCA checklist and action items.
Lisa (customer-success): Sent customers a status update and apology + ETA. They'll wait for final postmortem.
Jay (eng-runtime): Will push a runtime metric to track stranded capacity (gpus_free_incompatible_mig) and an alert at 500+ units.
Anna (oncall-sre): Handoff to daytime oncall @Marcus in 40m. Final note: incident mitigated but not fully resolved. Continue monitoring for 2h.
Marcus (platform): Acknowledged handoff. I'll coordinate the autoscaler bump and postmortem.
IncidentBot: INCIDENT STATUS: Mitigated -> Monitoring. Duration so far: 48m. Follow-up ticket: INC-2026-0312-eviction-repack-rfc.
Anna (oncall-sre): Closing pagerduty alert for oncall rotation, leaving channel open for follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
Lisa (customer-success): Thanks team. I have notes for the postmortem with impacted customers and timelines.
Jay (eng-runtime): Logging final runbook steps in infra repo: `docs/incidents/2026-03-12-gpu-stranding.md`
Marcus (platform): Adding autoscaler proposal PR.
Priya (eng-ml): Adding model sizing recommendation doc to the postmortem.
Anna (oncall-sre): Offboarding. If anything regresses ping pagerduty.
Anna (oncall-sre): last check at 14:58 UTC: queues stable ~200, latencies normal.
